summary: Edit Harga Cabang (branch price editing). BACKEND: new file tests/test_branch_price_edit.py, run with -n 0, passes 24/24. GET /api/branch-prices: Jombang sees its own store. These calls are rejected: jombang asking for pgs-jember, jember asking for pgs-jombang, sidoarjo and customer (403 each); admin asking for pgs-official or an unknown store (400); no token (401). Admin with pgs-jember works. skip/limit pages without overlap. PUT validation never writes to the DB: price <= 0 or min_qty 0 gives 422; unknown customer type, duplicate min_qty and more than 10 tiers give 400; a cross-branch store_id gives 403; a missing product gives 404; a variant product gives 400 (tested with a temporary TEST_ product, deleted afterwards). Happy path: only the Jombang store_stock row changes. Its stock stays the same, and the Jember row and the Sidoarjo product doc are unchanged. Tiers come back sorted and empty types are dropped. A price_history entry is written with source branch_price / 'Harga Cabang', with before/after for original_price, price and tier_prices, and it shows in /history/price-stock for Jombang but not for Jember. A save with no changes writes no history. Buyer side: with X-Store-Id pgs-jombang, GET /products/{id} and the /products list show the new price, the cart uses it at qty 1, 6 and 12 (220000 / 215000 / 210000), and Sidoarjo and Jember stay the same. /seller/inventory shows the branch price. Admin editing Jember leaves Jombang unchanged. FRONTEND (390px): Jombang login, then the 'Harga Cabang' tile in Seller Center, then /seller/branch-prices. The list, search, dialog, all 3 client-side validations, tier add/delete, save and cancel all work, and the saved values match the DB. Riwayat Harga & Stok shows the entry labelled 'Harga Cabang'. Admin: the menu item and the Jombang/Jember chips work, and admin can edit Jember. TWO BUGS: (1) the 'Harga jual cabang' and 'Harga coret' inputs in the dialog are only 18px wide, so the current price can't be seen. (2) A race when switching branch or searching can show one branch's data under the other branch's chip, and saving then writes it to the wrong branch. DATA: all edited rows were restored exactly (checked field by field). The branch_price price_history rows (4) and product_events rows (4) I created were deleted. The test carts were deleted. Branch-copy apply was NOT called. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: bp-input-price and bp-input-orig render 18px wide (measured bbox width=18, height=44 at 390px). The current price (e.g. 215000) is invisible and very hard to edit. Root cause: styles.input has `width: 10` plus flex:1. The two top inputs sit inside a column View (flex:1, minWidth:0), so flex:1 sizes the height, not the width, and the explicit width:10 stops them stretching. Tier inputs are fine because they sit in a row. Fix: give these two inputs width:'100%' (or alignSelf:'stretch'), or drop width:10 from the shared style and use it only for the row inputs. Reference: /app/frontend/app/seller/branch-prices.tsx:128,132,179

load() returns early when busy.current is true, so a branch-chip switch or a new search that fires while a request is still in flight is dropped. The in-flight response for the old branch/query is then shown. Reproduced (with the API delayed 1.5s): admin taps Jombang, then Jember after 500ms. The Jember chip is highlighted, but bp-store says 'Mitra PGS Jombang' and the list shows Jombang prices (Rp221.000). If the admin then opens a row and taps Simpan, the PUT goes to store_id=pgs-jember with Jombang's prefilled prices, so the wrong data is written to the other branch. Fix: track a request id or AbortController for reset loads and ignore stale responses instead of skipping new loads. Reference: /app/frontend/app/seller/branch-prices.tsx:32-46

issues: The tier rows have no column labels (only the placeholders 'Min. qty' / 'Harga', which disappear once a value is filled). The user sees two unnamed numbers per row.

bp-dialog-error sits at the end of the ScrollView. With many tiers the error is off-screen or half-hidden above the buttons (seen in the screenshot), and it stays visible after the user fixes the field. Move it next to the Batal/Simpan buttons, outside the ScrollView.
The '+ Tambah tingkat' touch target is 36px tall (below 44).

'Harga Cabang' is in the slide-in/sidebar menu for every non-admin seller, including sidoarjo@pgs.id (pgs-official) and third-party sellers. They get a 403 error screen. Show it only for pgs-jombang/pgs-jember stores (as seller/index.tsx already does). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/seller-shell.tsx:22
The intro text lists the sources (Ubah Produk, Edit Massal, Impor Excel, Manajemen Stok, Harga Grosir) but not 'Harga Cabang'.

action_items: HIGH: fix the collapsed bp-input-price / bp-input-orig width in branch-prices.tsx (remove width:10 for these, or use width:'100%').

HIGH: fix the load() race in branch-prices.tsx. Ignore stale responses (request counter or AbortController) instead of dropping new loads while busy, so branch/search changes always show the right data and the admin can't save one branch's prices into another.
Show the 'Harga Cabang' seller-shell menu item only for Jombang/Jember stores (and admin).
Minor: add column labels to the tier rows, move bp-dialog-error near the buttons and clear it when the user edits, and make '+ Tambah tingkat' at least 44px tall.
critical_code_review_comments: branch_price.py is clean. Auth goes through branch_for (admin -> must be a branch; others -> their own active store, which must be a branch). Validation runs before any write. It upserts with $setOnInsert stock 0, so stock is preserved. Before/after is recorded via history.record, which also emits product_events for watchers (expected).
Pydantic doesn't limit the tier list length before the code does (the MAX_TIERS check happens in the code). That is fine.
PUT always replaces the whole tier_prices of the branch row. A client that sends only one customer type will wipe the others (the UI always sends all of them). This is fine for the current UI.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all flows work; 2 HIGH UI bugs: collapsed price inputs, branch/search race)

rca_of_issue: Input width: styles.input combines flex:1 + width:10 (meant for row layouts). In a column parent, flex controls the height, so the width stays at 10 + padding = 18px. Race: busy.current guard in load() makes the newest reset load return early, and nothing triggers it again once the stale request finishes.
